newsitem.title: GERMANY: Trinkaus ups Daimler 96,97,98 EPS forecast.
newsitem.headline: Trinkaus ups Daimler 96,97,98 EPS forecast.

text.p: Germany's Trinkaus Capital Management said on Tuesday it had raised its EPS forecasts for Daimler-Benz AG for 1996, 1997 and 1998 following the dollar's rise above 1.60 marks.

In a statement, analyst Christian Breitsprecher said the dollar's advance would have a strong positive impact on the industrial group's earnings, improving its competitive position in export markets and allowing better returns on foreign earnings when translated into marks.

Breitsprecher raised his Daimler 1996 EPS forecast (on the basis of U.S. GAAP) to 3.30 marks from 3.10 marks, his 1997 forecast to four marks per share from 3.60 marks and his 1998 forecast to 5.90 marks from 5.10 marks.
The bank is keeping its "hold" recommendation on Daimler stock.
Daimler is set to officially approve a sweeping reorganisation plan at a supervisory board meeting on Thursday.
